body:
Operator, 2026-11-05. `blocked` is written by a small harness-specific plugin, extension or hook, pi first. Each should be tiny; Claude's is the one expected to break regularly, so it comes later and carries no weight in the design.

This fits d-state-writer: the harness is the party that knows it is asking a human, and it needs no fork of pi-zmx.

Confirmed by the operator: the plugin runs in the harness, and when ZMX_SESSION is set it writes that session's state as the harness waits on a human and resumes. It does not depend on pi-zmx.
title: Each harness gets a tiny state plugin of its own
